body: Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 26, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Jodi Meade, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55668  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, May 15,
  2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55669  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending May 31, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55670  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for May 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55671  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for May 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55672  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion to increase the parking meter
  rate to $3.00 per hour, at a 3-hour maximum.

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their

I, Kimberly Luna, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at

with Disabilities Act, please contact Kimberly Luna at Cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
